aoi_metric_definition.max_aoi: maximum pair AoI observed over post-warmup slots
aoi_metric_definition.mean_aoi: post-warmup mean over ordered source-receiver pairs and slots
aoi_metric_definition.mean_max_aoi: post-warmup mean of the per-slot maximum pair AoI
aoi_metric_definition.mean_min_aoi: post-warmup mean of the per-slot minimum pair AoI
aoi_metric_definition.min_aoi: minimum pair AoI observed over post-warmup slots

failure_model: silence: failed node cannot transmit, but remains as a receiver/source state
